About

Six-plus years, one thread: storytelling

I started Okay Pasal in 2018 because I wanted to understand commerce from the inside — not as theory, but as a business I had to run. Since then, I trained in photography and visual production at Percept Media Production, then completed a diploma in film direction at Kantipur Film Academy. The through-line is the same in every case: understand the audience, shape the story, ship the work.

Beyond that, I spend a lot of my time curious about researching and learning — every business idea, every new topic — just learning, understanding, and enjoying life with a lot of dreams.

  • 2018

    Founded Okay Pasal Pvt. Ltd.

    E-commerce growth through market research and AI-powered strategy.

  • Craft

    Percept Media Production

    Photography across product, event, and promotional work.

  • Training

AI Tips & Prompts

Copy & use
// Content idea generator
Give me 10 content ideas for [niche] that address a common mistake beginners make, written as scroll-stopping hooks.
// Business idea validator
Evaluate this business idea for [idea]: market size, biggest risk, and the fastest way to test it for under $100.
// Weekly content planner
Turn this long-form post into 5 short-form pieces for Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn, each with its own hook.
// Offer clarifier
Rewrite this service description so a stranger understands exactly what they get, in under 40 words.
// Shot list builder
Break this scene description into a shot list with framing, movement, and lens suggestions for a low-budget crew.
// AI tool triage
Given this task: [task], recommend one AI tool to use, one to avoid, and the single prompt to start with.
